messages:
elaine: Heads-up — I'm starting the multi-PR move/rename for the SDK docs today. Splitting into three PRs: #423 (core content), #424 (redirects/anchors), #425 (sdk renames). Need an explicit merge sequencing plan so the preview site doesn't show 404s. @sam can you take the merge ordering?

sam: Yep. Proposed order: core (#423) -> redirects (#424) -> sdks (#425). Redirects must land before the final rename PR to avoid broken anchors/links. I'll schedule merge windows and own gating.

mike: Quick note — we should auto-generate anchor redirect entries for any moved headings. I have a small script that maps old headings to new paths. I can attach it to the redirects PR.

frank: Also watch the indexer. Our search index job runs shortly after merges and sometimes errors when many paths change. Recommend running a targeted reindex run after each PR: `./tools/reindex --paths docs/sdk --staging`.

docs-bot: PR #423 preview available: https://preview.internal.redwood/pr/423 — Build: success, 2 warnings (anchor: /sdk/auth.md#login).

jen: Can we add a temporary redirect mapping for changed anchors (2 weeks) rather than relying on consumers to change links immediately? Less churn.

sam: Agreed. Gating plan: 1) Get approvals on core (#423) and green preview. 2) Merge core. 3) Run targeted reindex (frank to trigger). 4) Merge redirects (#424) and wait ~15 minutes for CDN/preview reconciliation. 5) Merge sdks (#425). I'll open a fixed 1-hour merge window and post it here.

elaine: Sounds good. I'll tag reviewers on each PR and add explicit "DO NOT MERGE #425 until #424 is live" in the PR description. Also adding a short checklist in each PR body for post-merge steps.

mike: Pushing the generator script to #424 branch now. It's a tiny python script that produces a `redirects.yaml` with anchor mappings. Will include a note about non-destructive preview behavior.

frank: Heads-up: in an earlier dry-run the netlify preview failed because of very long frontmatter titles (>120 chars). I trimmed a few titles in the core PR — re-run preview when ready.

sam: Good catch. @elaine can you add a pre-merge checklist item: run linter + short frontmatter length check? e.g. `make docs-lint`

elaine: Done. Checklist now contains: 1) CI green, 2) preview review, 3) docs-lint pass, 4) targeted reindex, 5) smoke curl tests against staging.

jen: I'll approve #423 once CI is green. Please ping when the reindex is complete.

mike: Redirects PR (#424) updated with auto-gen script and example `redirects.yaml` mapping. Waiting on reindex signal.

sam: Scheduling merge window: 2026-03-22 14:00 UTC for the sequence. I'll post a 30m reminder and coordinate merges live. Please don't merge out of band.

elaine: Thanks all — will post the final checklist in each PR and tag reviewers. :thumbsup:

sam: Reminder set. I'll also open a short rollback playbook in the release-war-room channel in case the indexer or previews break.

frank: If anything trips the indexer, run: ```./tools/reindex --paths docs/sdk --staging --retry 3``` and notify me.

elaine: Added rollback instructions to PR descriptions and pinned the reindex command. Thanks team!"
